newsitem.title: FRANCE: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JULY 1.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - FRANCE - LE MONDE - JULY 1.

text.p: These are leading stories in afternoon daily Le Monde.

-- Prime Minister Lionel Jospin in address to National Assembly Socialist group Tuesday does not rule out revenue raising measures in 1997, possibly through rise in taxes targetting business, depending on the outcome of the audit of public finances expected July 21. But main changes to be in 1998 budget.
-- New car registrations fell by 30.7 percent year-on-year and fell by 23.7 percent in the first six months of 1997.
-- Water supply utility Saur-Cise to cut some 300 jobs after merger and restructuring.
-- Paribas subsidiary Compagnie Bancaire to sell units UCB Invoice Discounting and UCB factoring to Bank of New York Financial Corp.
